boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ohio State University
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations on or near Ohio State’s Columbus campus with late-night service.

cards.title: Buckeye Donuts
cards.subtitle: 1998 N. High St., University District
cards.notes: Use the all-day menu for donuts, breakfast, gyros, salads, or coffee; confirm any holiday changes directly before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour campus-area counter with both sweet and savory food.
cards.evidence_claim: Buckeye Donuts identifies its 1998 N. High Street shop as the Ohio State campus location and states that it is open always, closed never.
cards.access_notes: Official site states: “Open always, closed never.”

cards.title: Charleys Cheesesteaks on High
cards.subtitle: 1980 N. High St., University District
cards.notes: Order a made-to-order sandwich, fries, wings, lemonade, shake, or ice-cream item; check the location page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A High Street quick-service option with posted service until 2:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Charleys’ official OSU Campus page lists 1980 N. High St. and store hours through 2:30 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 10:30 a.m.–2:30 a.m.

cards.title: Mikey’s Late Night Slice — OSU
cards.subtitle: 1839 N. Pearl St., Suite 130
cards.notes: Use the OSU location’s ordering page for a slice or pie and verify the day’s closing time before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A Pearl Street pizza counter with official ordering hours past 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikey’s official OSU ordering page lists the 1839 N. Pearl St. location and hours until 2:00–2:15 a.m.
cards.source_title: Mikey's Late Night Slice — OSU Ordering
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 2:15 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers — E. 11th Avenue
cards.title: Raising Cane’s on E. 11th
cards.subtitle: 10 E. 11th Ave., University District
cards.notes: Use the location page for chicken-finger meals and current service details; choose a pickup window that fits the posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent chicken-finger restaurant open through midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 10 E. 11th Avenue Columbus restaurant as a late-night location, open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists closing at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Red Chili Asian Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 1948 N. High St., University District
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s contact page for the day’s schedule, then plan a dinner or late takeout stop from its High Street address.
cards.short_summary: An Asian-fusion restaurant one address south of Buckeye Donuts.
cards.evidence_claim: Red Chili Asian Kitchen lists 1948 N. High Street and hours until midnight Wednesday through Monday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Wednesday–Monday; Tuesday closes at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: King’s Pizza on N. Fourth
cards.subtitle: 1950 N. 4th St., University District
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order through King’s direct ordering site and verify the day because Saturday closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: A North Fourth Street pizza option with weekday service to 3:45 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: King’s Pizza lists 1950 N. 4th St. and takeout hours until 3:45 a.m. Monday through Friday, plus late Sunday hours.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering site lists Monday–Friday 5:00 p.m.–3:45 a.m.; Sunday service resumes at midnight and runs to 3:45 a.m.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell Cantina — 1525 N. High St.
cards.title: Taco Bell Cantina on High
cards.subtitle: 1525 N. High St., University District
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check dine-in status, then order food from the taco, burrito, quesadilla, and nacho menu.
cards.short_summary: A High Street fast-food stop whose official page labels it open late.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 1525 N. High St. lists dine-in hours until 2:00 a.m. and identifies the restaurant as open late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Cantina — 1525 N. High St.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in service until 2:00 a.m.; verify the specific day’s hours on the page.

cards.title: Adriatico’s OSU
cards.subtitle: 1618 Neil Ave., University District
cards.notes: Use the official location page to choose carryout or delivery; Friday and Saturday have the latest posted service windows.
cards.short_summary: A Neil Avenue pizza restaurant with late weekend carryout and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Adriatico’s official OSU page lists 1618 Neil Ave.; Friday–Saturday carryout ends at midnight and delivery at 12:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday dine-in until 11:00 p.m., carryout until 12:00 a.m., and delivery until 12:30 a.m.

cards.title: Ohio State Pizza on Hudson
cards.subtitle: 325 E. Hudson St., near University District
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s direct ordering site for pickup or delivery, and confirm the evening’s actual cutoff before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A Hudson Street pizza-and-deli option with late service listed by its ordering channels.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State Pizza’s direct ordering site identifies the business at 325 E. Hudson St.; its current location listings show service extending into early morning.
cards.access_notes: Current ordering and location listings show late service; confirm the live order screen for that day’s cutoff before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Ackerman
cards.subtitle: 480 Ackerman Rd., north of campus
cards.notes: Check the official restaurant page before making the short north-campus run, then order from the standard food menu for pickup.
cards.short_summary: A north-of-campus Taco Bell with posted service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Columbus location finder identifies the 480 Ackerman Road restaurant as open until 3:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official Taco Bell location finder lists this nearby restaurant as open until 3:00 a.m.; verify the live daily hours before departure.
